page.overview:
Who is Diamond Tooth?

Diamond Tooth, also known as simply Diamond, is an Alpha Team Mission Deep Freeze minifigure introduced in 2004.

Diamond Tooth wears a black Mini Pixie Cap and the black standard Mission Deep Freeze Alpha Team uniform with a dark green right sleeve. His face is printed with a frowning facial expression, a black goatee, black sunglasses, a dark grey bandana, and a silver microphone.

Diamond Tooth is Alpha Team's mining expert. He is one of the new agents recruited by Alpha Team for Mission Deep Freeze. As an Alpha-3 agent, he pilots the Tundra Tracker.

After Radia is frozen by Ogel to prevent her from revealing his evil plans, Diamond Tooth drives the Tundra Tracker to rescue her. Upon discovering her location, he uses the Magma Drill to unfreeze her and then disables a nearby Ice Orb.
